exposure: First plasma C-reactive protein (CRP) values taken 6-8 hours postpartum
cohort: The study included 400 neonates, comprising term and late preterm infants, 28 of whom had cEONS and underwent plasma CRP measurements as part of a sepsis work-up.
finding: The first CRP value taken in neonates 6-8 hours postpartum showed a moderate predictive ability for cEONS at a 5.3 mg/L threshold (OR 1.4), but was ultimately a weak predictor due to poor sensitivity and high false-positive rates.
